_readme: Genre neighbour pack (source: acousticbrainz-ppmi-svd-mp (1958394 recordings; MediaEval AcousticBrainz Genre Dataset, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)). Per-label top-20 neighbours with mutual-proximity similarity scores in [0,1] (PPMI → truncated SVD d=32 → cosine → Mutual Proximity; umbrella labels damped ×0.5). Pairs absent from both lists score 0. Regenerate with scripts/build-genre-embedding.mjs.
source: acousticbrainz-ppmi-svd-mp (1958394 recordings; MediaEval AcousticBrainz Genre Dataset, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
